scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF comparison with a newly surfaced spec-derived DWG reader; refresh ACadRust claims, FreeCAD converter selection behavior, narrow DXF writer scope, and ACIS carrier boundaries; update implementation-readiness guidance without adding a gate.

method.kind: Primary-source project/release documentation review plus read-only plan cross-check
method.evidenceBoundary: This is a source/documentation screen, not a reproducible peer run. Project README/status claims are version- and corpus-dependent. Findings are admission/scope refinements only; ODA v5.4.1 remains the authoritative DWG byte-layout source under repository guidance.

evidence.topic: dwg-rs is an optional structural differential, not a semantic 3D oracle
observed: The project identifies itself as Apache-2.0, pre-alpha, and derived from the public ODA v5.4.1 specification.
Its documented decoder discipline requires parsed data fields to end at the version-specific string-stream or object-data boundary.
Its status lists decoders for MESH, POLYFACE/polygon mesh, 3DFACE and 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY, including versioned ACIS envelope/trailer fields for the sampled records.
Its geometry adapter documents 3DSOLID as a bounding-box placeholder; decoder coverage is explicitly alpha and the project reports skipped/error records.
README coverage summaries refer to different dated corpus sizes; aggregate percentages are not directly comparable and were not independently reproduced.
doesNotEstablish: A second normative specification or independent source-native expected manifest.
Full entity coverage across every DWG version or producer.
DXF parsing, DWG writing acceptance, ACIS B-rep validity, or AcDs owner/key/payload semantic closure.
evidence.planUse: Optional, gap-triggered, exact-version structural differential only. If used, pin commit/toolchain/input hashes and compare same-record handle/type, disposition and boundary consumption against ODA plus source-authored expected values. Do not install for routine slices or add a permanent dependency.

evidence.topic: Mutable ACadRust capability claims must not be transferred across releases
evidence.observed: Current mutable project documentation advertises ASCII/binary DXF and DWG read/write, 48 top-level entity variants, ACIS SAT/SAB parsing and writing, B-rep topology and primitive builders, with Linux/Windows/macOS CI. The previously reviewed v0.6.4 artifact is a different, pinned state; no current-main immutable artifact or complete test provenance was established here. Application consumers use the same codec lineage.
evidence.planUse: Retain one optional ACadRust parser/producer lineage. Future use requires exact source/release, artifact, feature and toolchain identity, an independent source geometry manifest, and per-object loss reporting. Do not promote support from README claims or same-codec round trips.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD automatic converter mode can mix DWG-to-DXF routes
observed: DWG import calls an external converter and then the selected DXF importer.
The automatic preference tries LibreDWG, ODA and QCAD routes as available; explicit preference values select individual routes.
The conversion helper treats output-file existence as success and does not use the subprocess return code as its success predicate.
evidence.planUse: At the already-planned native platform checkpoint, select a single converter per run, record executable/version/hash, argv and exit status, validate the exact output DXF hash/size/magic/version, and bind that artifact to the importer backend and open/insert result. Record fallbacks separately; never pool them into one converter result.

evidence.topic: Newly surfaced narrow DXF writer does not add 3D coverage
evidence.observed: The project describes a Go, write-only R2010 DXF library whose current supported set is a small 2D entity/table subset; it does not read DXF and emits geometry at Z=0.
evidence.planUse: Exclude from the 3D/DWG comparator set; no installation or test is justified.

evidence.topic: Typed ACIS entity construction and raw browsing are not ACIS geometry support
evidence.observed: ezdxf documents that creation of ACIS entity data requires an external library and that its ACIS browser displays/exports raw SAT/SAB content. LibreDWG issue #1411 reports silent loss of R2013+ AcDs-backed ACIS data on a named LibreDWG build; it remains a report for that route and is not local libdxfrw evidence.
evidence.planUse: Keep carrier bytes, DWG entity-to-AcDs association, payload decoding, B-rep semantics and native consumer acceptance as distinct gates. Treat the LibreDWG report as a negative-control lead only after exact reproduction provenance is pinned.

ownersRefined: DWG per-version structural differential / record-boundary diagnosis
